selection.name: 인클라인 덤벨 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on a incline bench about 35 degrees, feet secured, pressing load above chest. Use equipment: two dumbbells, incline bench about 35 degrees. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케이블 리버스 플라이
selection.pose_description: Standing facing two cable columns, crossing opposite handles in front and opening arms sideways at shoulder height.

selection.name: 바벨 리스트 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated with forearms supported on thighs, only wrists curling load upward. Palms up. Use equipment: barbell, bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 리버스 런지
selection.pose_description: Split stance, lowering rear knee toward floor with front foot planted. Step backward into the lunge. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 니 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Knees and palms on floor, knees remain in contact with floor, straight line from knees to shoulders, bending elbows in a knee-supported push-up.

selection.name: 덤벨 업라이트 로우
selection.pose_description: Standing, pulling load vertically close to torso with elbows rising out to sides. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 프리쳐 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated, upper arms supported on angled preacher pad, elbows flexing to curl load. Use two dumbbells.

selection.name: 바이시클 크런치
selection.pose_description: Lying on back, shoulder blades lifted, twisting opposite elbow toward bent knee while other leg extends.

selection.name: 스미스머신 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on FLAT bench inside Smith frame, pressing bar along fixed vertical rails over chest.

selection.name: 케이블 레터럴 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing, raising arm sideways to shoulder height. Cable attached to LOW pulley and handle held in working hand. Use equipment: cable machine, single handle. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 라잉 트라이셉 익스텐션
selection.pose_description: Lying on flat bench, upper arms vertical, bending elbows to lower load toward forehead then extending elbows. Use equipment: two dumbbells, flat bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 트랩바 데드리프트
selection.pose_description: Standing hip hinge, neutral back, lowering load close to legs and extending hips. Conventional stance: feet hip-width, grip outside knees, load starts on floor. Use equipment: trap bar. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 디클라인 덤벨 플라이
selection.pose_description: Lying on a decline bench, head LOWER than hips, ankles secured, opening two dumbbells sideways with softly bent elbows.

selection.name: 케이블 슈러그
selection.pose_description: Standing with arms straight down holding load, elevating shoulders toward ears without bending elbows. Use equipment: cable machine. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 리스트 롤러
selection.pose_description: Standing arms forward, both hands holding wrist roller handle with rope and hanging weight, rotating wrists to wind rope.

selection.name: 행잉 니 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Hanging from horizontal bar, raising bent knees toward chest. Use equipment: pull-up bar. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 디클라인 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on a decline bench with head lower than hips and ankles secured, pressing a BARBELL over lower chest.

selection.name: 케이블 익스터널 로테이션
selection.pose_description: Standing beside cable column, working elbow bent 90 degrees against side, rotating forearm OUTWARD away from abdomen.

selection.name: 인클라인 덤벨 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated reclined on incline bench, upper arms hanging down, curling dumbbells. Palms face upward. Use equipment: two dumbbells, incline bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케틀벨 고블릿 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Both feet planted, bending knees and hips with neutral spine. One weight held with both hands at chest. Use equipment: kettlebell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 디클라인 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Hands on floor and feet elevated on a stable bench, straight body descending from feet toward head, bending elbows to lower chest.

selection.name: 시티드 덤벨 리어 레터럴 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Seated on a bench, torso hinged forward over thighs, holding two dumbbells and raising arms sideways, emphasizing posterior shoulders.

selection.name: 바벨 라잉 트라이셉 익스텐션
selection.pose_description: Lying on flat bench, upper arms vertical, bending elbows to lower load toward forehead then extending elbows. Use equipment: barbell, flat bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덩키 킥
selection.pose_description: On hands and knees, extending one hip backward and upward with knee bent.

selection.name: 스미스머신 인클라인 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on visibly INCLINED bench inside Smith frame, pressing guided bar above upper chest.

selection.name: 원암 랜드마인 프레스
selection.pose_description: Standing, one hand pressing free end of anchored barbell upward and forward along an angled arc. Use equipment: barbell, landmine anchor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케이블 해머컬
selection.pose_description: Standing facing LOW pulley, holding rope with neutral thumbs-up grip, elbows by ribs, curling upward.

selection.name: 캣 카우 스트레치
selection.pose_description: On hands and knees with spine gently rounded upward in cat stretch, shoulders above wrists and hips above knees.

selection.name: 인클라인 덤벨 플라이
selection.pose_description: Lying on a visibly inclined bench about 35 degrees, arms opening wide with slightly bent elbows, one dumbbell in each hand.

selection.name: 시티드 바벨 숄더 프레스
selection.pose_description: Seated upright on bench, pressing load overhead. Use equipment: barbell, upright bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 사이드 라잉 클램
selection.pose_description: Lying on side with hips and knees bent, feet together, opening upper knee upward.

selection.name: 브이 업
selection.pose_description: Balancing on hips, torso and straight legs lifted into a V, hands reaching toward toes.

selection.name: 덤벨 불가리안 스플릿 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Stationary split stance, both feet remain planted, bending front and rear knees. Rear foot elevated on bench. Use equipment: two dumbbells, bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 글루트 킥백 머신
selection.pose_description: Torso supported by machine chest pad, one foot pressing rear lever backward through hip extension.

selection.name: 스탠딩 햄스트링 컬 머신
selection.pose_description: Standing supported by hamstring curl machine, one ankle against roller, bending working knee backward.

selection.name: 케이블 트위스트
selection.pose_description: Standing side-on to cable pulley at chest height, hands together gripping handle, rotating torso horizontally.

selection.name: 원레그 익스텐션
selection.pose_description: Seated in leg extension machine, only ONE knee straightening against shin roller, other leg relaxed.

selection.name: 바벨 스탠딩 카프 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing with knees straight, rising onto balls of feet by lifting heels. Bar rests on upper back. Use equipment: barbell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케이블 크런치
selection.pose_description: Kneeling facing high cable pulley, rope beside head, curling torso downward using abdominal flexion.

selection.name: 점핑잭
selection.pose_description: Jumping jack with legs spread and both arms overhead, body upright; no equipment.
